ambient: The moment continues, and is not shorter for having continued.
Something is decided somewhere and does not concern you.
The floor becomes slightly more certain of itself.
description: You have arrived somewhere in the middle of it and it has been going on. There is a floor, or the strong impression of one. Time here is being handled by somebody else and they are doing it generously. Nothing needs you.
name: The Long Moment

looks: You test it. It agrees to be a floor and continues.
It goes down a long way and every bit of it is this bit.
objects.name: the floor

looks: Still going. It has been very generous so far.
You look for the edge of it and find more of the middle.
It is thinning at one end, but not yet, and not soon.
objects.name: the moment
